questions.stem: A sphere has a volume of $\frac{500}{3}\pi\text{ cm}^3$. What is its radius?
questions.explanation: $\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3 = \frac{500}{3}\pi$. Dividing both sides by $\pi$: $\frac{4}{3}r^3 = \frac{500}{3}$, so $4r^3 = 500$, $r^3 = 125$, $r = 5\text{ cm}$. Note that option (d) $\sqrt[3]{125} = 5$ also, but option (a) gives the simplified value.
